entities.summary: Ramchundra (Ramachandra Lal) (Devanagari,रामचन्द्र लाल) (c. 1821–1880) was a British Indian mathematician. His book, Treatise on Problems of Maxima and Minima, was promoted by mathematician Augustus De Morgan.
